bifrost: bifrost_app::usernotif (springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs), shell registry springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs, delivery UI springboard/src/shell/notify/
summary: Local notifications are covered: categories with buttons, destructive and text-reply actions, requests with title, subtitle, body, thread, category, a time-interval delay and a Dock badge, removal and listing of delivered and pending requests, and the user's response (also queued for an app that is not running). Remote push (APNs, device tokens, background push, the notification service extension), calendar and location triggers, communication notifications, attachments, per-request sounds, notification settings queries and the foreground presentation delegate are not covered.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs:225, springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs:41; wired: springboard/src/shell/notify/permission.rs; springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs (usernotif_hold, usernotif_ask_tick, usernotif_answer); springboard/sdk/src/usernotif_model.rs (AuthorizationStore, AuthorizationOptions, AuthorizationStatus, Settings); built 2026-10-17: springboard/proto/src/rich.rs (NOTIF_AUTH_MASK, NotifyAuthorize codec), springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs (request_authorization, Event::Authorization), springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs (usernotif_authorize, usernotif_ask_first_time)
features.note: Permission is a static manifest entry ("notifications"); there is no runtime prompt, no authorization options (alert, sound, badge) and no authorization status query. Without the permission every add answers NotPermitted. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity. Added: the authorization state machine (notDetermined to authorized, denied or provisional; asked once, persisted as text) and the settings snapshot. Model built and unit tested on the host (springboard/sdk/src/usernotif_model.rs); not yet wired to the shell wire protocol or the UI, so Midget check pending. Built 2026-10-17: requestAuthorization over the wire (ToShell::NotifyAuthorize tag 0x14b, ToApp::NotificationAuthorized tag 57) with the SDK call usernotif::request_authorization and Event::Authorization. The shell answers at once for an app asked before (granted while its alerts are not muted), and an app never asked waits for the first-time alert, then gets the person's answer. tests proto rich::tests::notification_authorization_round_trips, sdk tests parity_sdk-tests-04 headless_request_authorization_sends_the_known_option_bits_and_drops_the_rest, shell usernotif::tests::an_authorization_waits_for_its_own_app_only. Not yet run on the host or Midget. Built 2026-10-17 (per-option grants): each app's grant is kept as badge, sound, alert and provisional bits in authorization.ini; a provisional request is granted at once with no prompt; the settings query and the Dock badge follow the grant; critical alerts are never granted. Tests: shell usernotif::tests::grants_are_kept_per_option_and_survive_a_reload. Sound and banner gating per option are not yet wired.

features.apple: UNUserNotificationCenter add, removeDeliveredNotifications, removePendingNotificationRequests, getDeliveredNotifications, getPendingNotificationRequests
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs (add, remove_delivered, remove_pending, delivered, pending); springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs (Registry); springboard/sdk/src/usernotif_model.rs (Sound, Attachment, CalendarTrigger, IntervalTrigger); springboard/src/shell/services/notification_schedule.rs; springboard/proto/src/rich.rs (NotifRequest); springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-04.rs (tests)
features.note: Covers add with identifier replacement, removal by identifier or all, and the delivered and pending lists; the add, remove, query and trigger rules are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-04.rs.Pending is capped at 64 per app (MAX_PENDING); A request now carries a per-request sound (default, named, critical), a bounded userInfo map (16 entries, 512 characters per value), an interruption level and a relevance score over the wire and in the notification-schedule service (springboard/proto/src/rich.rs, springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs). Delivery does not yet play the sound or return userInfo in the response. Added: UNNotificationSound validation (named, defaultCritical, critical volume), attachment validation by type and size, DateComponents calendar matching with DST handling (nextTriggerDate), repeating interval minimum of 60 s (enforced in the notification-schedule service). Model built and unit tested on the host (springboard/sdk/src/usernotif_model.rs); not yet wired to the shell wire protocol or the UI, so Midget check pending. Remote push and the service extension stay gaps. Round (notify-stacks): the request's thread is kept on the delivered notification (springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs:380) and stacks per app and thread (springboard/src/shell/notify/store.rs:373 groups, :352 clear_thread). Not verified on Midget. Built 2026-10-17: the pending list (NotifyQuery with delivered false) and the removal of pending requests (NotifyRemove with delivered false) now cover calendar requests as well as interval ones, through Shell::usernotif_pending and Shell::usernotif_remove_pending; the removal of delivered requests was already on the wire. Tests: shell services::notification_schedule::tests::the_pending_list_and_removal_cover_both_kinds. Not run on the host or Midget.

Taps and action buttons arrive as Event::Response, including text-reply text, and are queued when the app is not running. The Response fields, the default action and the foreground presentation rules are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-04.rs.No willPresent hook: the app cannot choose presentation options for a notification that arrives while it is in front. Added: the willPresent decision model (banner, list, sound, badge cut to the user's settings; no delegate shows nothing). Model built and unit tested on the host (springboard/sdk/src/usernotif_model.rs); not yet wired to the shell wire protocol or the UI, so Midget check pending. Built 2026-10-17: willPresent. An app opts in with usernotif::set_presentation_delegate (ToShell 0x14d); a notification that arrives while the app is in front is sent as ToApp 58 NotificationWillPresent, and usernotif::will_present answers with the presentation bits (ToShell 0x14c). The answer is cut to the grant and the mute state; no answer within 1 s hides it. The app without the delegate keeps the banner it always had (Apple hides it), which is not yet matched. Tests: proto rich::tests::notification_will_present_round_trips, sdk tests parity_sdk-tests-04 headless_will_present_opt_in_and_reply_send_the_known_bits_only, shell usernotif::tests::a_held_presentation_is_taken_once_and_expires_unanswered and presentation_is_cut_to_what_the_grant_and_mute_allow.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/notification_schedule.rs (Trigger::Interval and Trigger::Calendar, Trigger::next_trigger_date, Trigger::validate, Schedule::checked_interval, Schedule::checked_calendar); springboard/sdk/src/usernotif_model.rs (CalendarTrigger, DateComponents, IntervalTrigger)
features.note: Host tests a_repeating_interval_under_a_minute_is_refused, a_daily_calendar_trigger_is_the_next_local_time_after_now and a_weekday_calendar_trigger_skips_other_days (sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01e.rs). usernotif_model::CalendarTrigger matches year, month, day, weekday, hour, minute and second, follows the zone's offset at the fire time, and is tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-44.rs (leap days, a year-pinned date, a weekday, an impossible component, a zone offset). Gap: the notification-schedule service's wire form still carries only hour, minute and weekday, so month, day and year triggers are not sent to the shell; a next-trigger query for a request already pending in the shell is not offered; location and push triggers need hardware or a service that does not exist here. Round (notify-stacks): pending interval and calendar requests are saved to pending-notifications.ini and restored on the first tick with their trigger times (springboard/src/shell/services/notification_schedule.rs: restore, persist, encode, decode; springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs:124 pending_rows, :129 restore_pending). Host-tested with a fake clock across two shells (pending_requests_survive_a_restart_and_keep_their_trigger_times). Sound, userInfo and interruption level are not saved. Not verified on Midget. Built 2026-10-17: ToShell::NotifySchedule (tag 0x14c, rich::NotifTrigger: an interval or a calendar trigger with a weekday bit set) sent by sdk usernotif::schedule; the shell keeps calendar requests in usernotif::Registry with the interval ones (Shell::usernotif_schedule) and the notification-schedule service saves them and fires them on time, also after a restart. Month, day and year triggers still do not go over the wire. Tests: proto rich::tests::notification_schedule_round_trips_both_triggers, rich::tests::notification_schedule_rejects_bad_triggers; sdk parity_sdk-tests-04 headless_a_scheduled_request_sends_its_trigger_with_its_content; shell services::notification_schedule::tests::a_wire_calendar_request_is_saved_and_fires_after_a_restart. Not run on the host or Midget.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 2 (user-notifications-ui, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No attachment API. Notification cards show text only. The shell has image drawing (springboard/render/src/imgdec, springboard/src/shell/notify/list.rs) that could carry an image thumbnail.

The SDK model holds the default, critical, critical-with-volume and named sounds and checks each against the grant (a critical sound needs the critical-alert grant, others the sound setting). Host tests sound_names_are_capped_at_255_bytes, critical_sounds_need_the_critical_alert_grant and critical_volume_must_be_between_zero_and_one (sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01e.rs). Delivery does not yet play a per-request sound and the sound is not in the shell wire protocol; the only sound control in the shell is the per-app Sounds switch in Settings (springboard/src/shell/notify_page.rs, not cited for this evidence). Built 2026-10-17: the delivery plan (usernotif::delivery_plan) plays a request's sound only with the sound option, an unmuted app and a sound in the request; a named sound goes to the shell's alert tones (apphost::queue_request_sound), and default and critical sounds play the first alert tone. Test: shell usernotif::tests::delivery_follows_the_alert_and_sound_options. Not run on the host or Midget.

features.note: Wave 4 (w4-user-notifications, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The user side is complete: per-app lock screen, Notification Center, banner, badges, previews and grouping, plus Do Not Disturb and per-app mute. The authorization store, the settings flags and the settings query are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-04.rs. Apps read their settings with usernotif::settings, which carries a Focus flag; the shell side of that flag is not verified on Midget. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity. Round (notify-stacks): Show Previews is honoured in banners and lists (springboard/src/shell/notify/mod.rs:557 previews_hidden, start_banner at :400). Focus modes (springboard/src/shell/notify/modes.rs): Do Not Disturb, Work, Personal and Sleep plus custom modes, each with allowed apps, allowed people (matched by exact name; the app protocol does not yet pass a sender, so people only match once it does), a time-sensitive allowance and an optional weekday schedule that may cross midnight. One mode is on by hand or by its schedule, and a manual choice wins. Delivery follows the active mode, and silenced notifications stay in Notification Center without a banner or wake. The choice is saved in focus_modes.ini next to notifications.ini. Covered by host unit tests (schedule across midnight and weekdays, delivery decisions, persistence) and a restart test in springboard/src/shell/focus.rs. Not built: the Control Centre list of modes (the tile still toggles Do Not Disturb and its subtitle names the mode on), the menu bar Focus glyph and a Settings page for modes and their allowed people; time-sensitive is not yet set by the app protocol. Not verified on Midget.
A badge number on a request and a short label on the dock icon are both available.

features.feature: APS entitlements and push testing tools
features.apple: APS Environment (macOS) entitlement, Sending push notifications using command-line tools, Push Notification Console
features.note: Entitlement and Apple-hosted testing tools belong to APNs. Nothing to match until remote push exists.

gaps: Remote push: no device token, no push registration, no background push wake-up (APNs or a BifrOSt equivalent).
Notification service extension: no hook to modify a notification before it is shown.
Calendar and location triggers: only a time-interval delay exists; no repeating or region-based notifications.
Attachments and per-request sounds: notification cards are text only and the sound is a per-app switch.
Runtime permission flow and settings query: permission is a manifest flag; there is no authorization status, no request options and no UNNotificationSettings equivalent.
Foreground presentation delegate (willPresent): an app cannot choose how a notification shows while it is in front.
Communication notifications and web push: no sender-based message notification and no Push API for the browser.
